OFFICE OF THE SUPERINTENDENT

CALL FOR QUOTATIONS NOTICE
Notice No.: 95808/S3/2026
Date:11-11-2026
Sub: GGH, Kakinada – Electrical Section – Procurement of electrical
materials required for day-to-day repairs and maintenance works –
Calling for quotations through NIC Portal – Reg.
***
Quotations are hereby invited from interested and eligible
suppliers for the supply of electrical materials required for day-to-day
repairs and maintenance works in various departments of Government
General Hospital, Kakinada.
The details of the required materials and specifications are
furnished below. Interested suppliers are requested to quote their rates
against each item.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
1. Suppliers shall quote their rates against each item separately as per
the specifications mentioned above.
2. Rates shall be quoted inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation
and other charges.
3. GST registration details shall be furnished along with the quotation.
4. Suppliers shall mention the make, brand and specifications of the
materials quoted.
5. The rates quoted shall be valid for a period of one year from the date
of approval, subject to the terms of approval.
6. The hospital reserves the right to accept or reject any or all
quotations without assigning any reason.
7. Submission of quotations shall not confer any right on the supplier
for placement of purchase orders. Procurement shall be made as and
when required, subject to actual requirement and availability of budget.
Interested suppliers are requested to submit their quotations to
the Office of the Superintendent by duly addressing it to The
Superintendent Government General Hospital, Kakinada and
mentioning the notice number on the sealed envelope within the
stipulated period.
